rationale: This video compresses a proposed input-prompt-output workflow into edited footage of a physical monitor. The protocol therefore prioritizes exact UI identity, the photographed input and attachment, prompt wording, hover-linked state change, distinct exercise/result signatures, TTS-versus-listening evidence, mnemonic input/output, carrier conflicts, and every missing bridge that montage order does not prove.

captureActions.carrier: visible brand text, quiz result, filmed-monitor environment, opening caption
captureActions.reason: Close the opening promise, initial result state, DeepSeek label, and physical filming setup.
captureActions.expectedObservation: DeepSeek text on the already-open quiz, four-option layout, opening caption, and recurring desk/monitor cues; URL/model/version/account may remain unreadable.

captureActions.carrier: photographed vocabulary input, narration caption, chat/attachment context
captureActions.reason: Identify the input document and test whether upload/send is shown.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Portrait vocabulary/reference sheet on the monitor, readable title/entries if possible, burned caption, and no continuous upload/send action unless captured.

captureActions.carrier: HTML quiz UI, pointer movement, option-row state and answer note
captureActions.reason: Prove exactly what changes on hover and preserve the quiz's literal text and layout.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Before state with four options; pointer approaches or rests on option A; row becomes highlighted and a green answer annotation appears without an observed click.

captureActions.carrier: burned captions versus raw SRT and audible narration
captureActions.reason: Capture each cue's caption form so consequential ASR substitutions can be recorded without rewriting the raw cue.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Caption proposals for all 17 cue midpoints, especially 习题单词/鼠标悬停即可/提示词/补全选择题/完形填空/附赠/听力题/生成.

captureActions.carrier: chat UI identity, prompt, 640.webp attachment, response and HTML requirement
captureActions.reason: Read the video-specific prompt and visible file/UI identity while checking for hidden execution gaps.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Prompt requests extraction of image words, a grade-level English completion multiple-choice exercise, and browser-openable HTML; attachment 640.webp with visible size; chat response text but no demonstrated save/open bridge.

captureActions.carrier: cloze page, inline selectors, selected-answer state, Chinese detailed analysis
captureActions.reason: Differentiate the additional exercise type from the later answer-analysis state and count only visible structures.
captureActions.expectedObservation: 阿拉斯加冒险日记（完形填空） page with multiple inline drop-down blanks, followed by a separate state with blue-highlighted text and Chinese answer-analysis rows.

captureActions.carrier: listening-comprehension UI and possible playback control/state
captureActions.reason: Separate the author's TTS claim from what the listening page and source audio actually establish.
captureActions.expectedObservation: 阿拉斯加冒险日记（听力理解） title, blue control/header area, English passage and choices; any play icon/status if readable; no assumption of audible playback.

captureActions.carrier: unit vocabulary sheet, mnemonic request, grouped mnemonic response
captureActions.reason: Close the second input-output example and avoid inferring retention efficacy or upload steps.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Visible English/Chinese vocabulary entries with page references, an attached image/request for associative memorization, and grouped Chinese mnemonic explanations; upload/send and learning outcome remain unshown.

captureActions.carrier: transition to inserted classroom cartoon, English text, watermark, closing caption
captureActions.reason: Resolve the cartoon's referent, visible text/watermark, and lack of a demonstrated generation bridge.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Edited transition from chat output to animated classroom; teacher/students; English sentence progressively revealed; watermark-like Chinese mark; no visible DeepSeek attribution or generation/export chain.

captureActions.carrier: boundary-adjacent visual states and recurring physical setup
captureActions.reason: Test whether technical shot boundaries reflect semantic scene changes or changes within the same filmed monitor/desk context.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Recurring monitor, keyboard, decorative lights, controllers, and desk across most boundaries; some inserted/direct screen material may differ; hidden cuts remain possible.

captureActions.carrier: full-timeline visible controls, labels, qualifiers, CTA/access and product-boundary opportunities
captureActions.reason: Bound negative evidence for access route, URL/model/version/account, price/region/support, download/save/open controls, and unshown workflow bridges.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Document which sought elements are not observed across all 0.5-second frames and which are merely off-screen or unreadable; do not claim universal absence.

stoppingRules: Every critical question CQ-01 through CQ-13 is answered or explicitly unknown with bounded evidence.
Every meaning change MC-01 through MC-10 has targeted visual and/or audio evidence.
All available carriers CAR-01 through CAR-13 are inspected; non-speech audio has semantic classifier evidence rather than metadata alone.
The DeepSeek label and whale-like chat logo are separated from unknown URL/model/version/account/workspace fields.
The photographed input, 640.webp attachment, prompt wording, browser-openable HTML request, and visible response are captured without inventing send/save/open actions.
The hover sequence contains before, during, and after frames and does not infer a click.
Cloze, answer-analysis, listening, and mnemonic states retain literal titles/signatures and conservative counts.
The TTS claim is separated from visible listening-page evidence and any missing audible playback proof.
Every consequential SRT conflict is preserved with the raw form, alternative carrier form, supported interpretation, and unresolved remainder.
The cartoon's source and generation relation remain unknown unless directly established; edit adjacency is not treated as causality.
Technical shots are not converted into semantic scene/edit counts, and the recurring physical setup is represented.
All decision-relevant absence statements cite the fully inspected 0-29.8 second scope or a bounded opportunity interval.
The opening-to-closing semantic relation is represented in knowledge units and relation graph.
The meta-gate reports no unchecked information carrier, meaning change, or knowledge relationship.
declaredUnknowns: Exact product URL, DeepSeek model/version, account/login state, workspace, and browser identity.
Source and ownership of both photographed vocabulary materials.
Whether the visible 640.webp file is exactly the photograph shown earlier.
Hidden upload, send, run/generate, copy, save, export, download, browser-open, and playback actions.
Whether the chat response contains complete executable HTML code and how it became the shown pages.
Whether TTS audio was generated or played, and its voice/settings.
Whether every option/question supports the shown hover behavior.
Retention efficacy of the mnemonic method.
Source/authorization of the inserted classroom cartoon and whether it was generated by DeepSeek or another tool.
Exact edit count or hidden cuts despite technical shot boundaries.
Any price, region, account requirement, support entity, or external access path not visible in the inspected source.
